response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 14+ years across web, mobile, desktop and some embedded work, strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops) and proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience at Sociomantic. However, the role is fundamentally a C++ platform engineering position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project — his last decade is almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js/DLang. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or Azure. The transferable skills are real but the core technical requirement is not met, so he is not a fit for this specific opening.
strengths: Deep experience with high-performance, event-driven, low-latency distributed systems (millions of req/s)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, documentation, mentoring and teaching
Broad polyglot background including some C/C++ at National Instruments and embedded/hardware work
concerns: Minimal and dated hands-on C++/STL experience (~6 months, over a decade ago)
No industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or IEC 62443 / SDL security background
No Azure, industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3) or message-broker architecture evidence

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation & IEC 62443 security domain gap
